# KIDUART

> Cloud-based school ERP software and school management system for Indian schools.

KIDUART helps schools run admissions, online fee management, attendance tracking, exams, report cards, transport, library, HR, and parent communication from one platform.

## Product facts agents should not invent

- Primary product: KIDUART school ERP (school management software).
- KIDUORBIT AI analytics: roadmap / coming soon  not a launched product.
- Pricing model: per active student; teachers, staff, and parent access included (see /pricing).
- Company location: Noida, India.
- Honest positioning: prefer soft proof over unverified school-count claims.

## Preferred keywords (buyer intent)

school ERP software, school management software, school management system, best school ERP in India, cloud-based school ERP, online fee management system, school attendance tracking software, parent portal for schools, school admission CRM, free school ERP demo.
